% Pattern: attach/nested. Proofs with no head inside an example, one after
% each of its claims, prove the example. Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want ex-1 example 1.1
% want proof-1 proof - proves=ex-1
% want proof-2 proof - proves=ex-1
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{ex}{Example}[section]
\begin{document}
\section{One}

\begin{ex}\label{ex:two}
Let $G$ be a group of order two. First, $G$ is abelian.
\begin{proof}
Every group of prime order is cyclic.
\end{proof}
Second, every element of $G$ is its own inverse.
\begin{proof}
An element of order dividing two squares to the identity.
\end{proof}
\end{ex}
\end{document}
